Maria (Partnerships): Hey team — prepping the evidence bundle for the marketplace publisher + the joint SI announcement next month. Need final security artifacts: SOC2 full report (latest), external pen-test report + remediation attestation, completed vendor questionnaire, redacted artifact files with presigned links, HSM/KMS attestation or diagrams, and a primary contact for the SI security lead. Deadline: EOD Fri (two weeks). Who owns each item? Ping if blocked.
Alex (Security): I can own SOC2 and the questionnaire. SOC2 is in the secure evidence bucket under `redwood-marketplace/evidence/soc2/v2024-09`. I'll prepare a 1‑page attestation. Ops needs to presign links to hand to publisher.
Dan (Platform): Presign flow OK from platform side. Suggest path `s3://rdw-marketplace-evidence/partners/acme/`. I'll create a folder and README. Recommended TTL 7d for partner presigns. Example presign command: ```
aws s3 presign s3://rdw-marketplace-evidence/partners/acme/soc2-v2024-09.pdf --expires-in 604800
```
Tell me the exact filenames and I'll generate links when files land.
Jess (Eng-Infra): Pen-test artifacts need redaction before presign. I can run the redaction pipeline if someone uploads the raw archive and a redaction checklist. We have `docs/marketplace/redaction-guidelines.md` as the source of truth.
Maria (Partnerships): @Alex confirm redaction fields. @Dan please create the S3 folder and a short-lived presign by Wed. Also we need the KMS/HSM attestation from infra (key rotation logs + access policy snapshot).
Alex (Security): Confirm redaction scope: remove internal IPs/hostnames, PRs/commits, credential snippets, customer PII. We'll produce both a redacted artifact and a redaction manifest (CSV) listing removed sections/line ranges.
Dan (Platform): Done — created `s3://rdw-marketplace-evidence/partners/acme/` and added `README.txt` placeholder. Lifecycle: objects in `partners/*` get a 30d auto-delete if unclaimed; presigns will be 7d. Tagging policy now.
Jess (Eng-Infra): For HSM/KMS attestation I can export key rotation metadata + CloudTrail snippet and a short diagram of where KMS is used. ETA Thu EOD for initial artifact.
compliance-bot: checklist snapshot: [SOC2 report (v2024-09), pen-test report + remediation statement, vendor questionnaire (signed), presigned artifact links, redaction manifest, HSM/KMS attestation, publisher contact list]. Status flags: SOC2=draft, pen-test=scheduled, questionnaire=ready, presigns=pending.
Maria (Partnerships): Note on announcement gating: legal requires SOC2 + pen remediation note before we publish. Marketing needs final copy approval. Target announce date 2025-05-12. If any artifact slips, we'll delay.
Alex (Security): @Jess can you confirm pen-test completion ETA and who signs remediation attestation (security head vs vendor)?
Jess (Eng-Infra): Pen-test window scheduled 2025-04-29. Vendor will deliver report by 2025-05-06. I'll draft remediation attestation; security head will sign off after internal triage.
Maria (Partnerships): Please drop primary contacts (name + email) for the publisher bundle. I will submit the bundle once presigns exist.
Dan (Platform): Contacts: alex@redwood.ai, jess@redwood.ai, maria@redwood.ai, infra-ops@redwood.ai
Alex (Security): Add compliance@redwood.ai for SOC ops and attestation sign-off.
Maria (Partnerships): Great — plan: assemble bundle when presigns are live. Call out any blockers (redaction, presign, attestation) here. :thumbsup:
Jess (Eng-Infra): Will post redaction manifest link here when ready.
Alex (Security): Uploading SOC2 summary + questionnaire answers later today.
compliance-bot: updated: SOC2=uploaded (summary), presigns=waiting, pen-test=scheduled.
Maria (Partnerships): Follow-ups: (1) Dan create presign folder & policy by Wed, (2) Jess run redaction + upload by 2025-05-07, (3) Alex attach SOC2 attestation and questionnaire today. Reconvene Friday 10:00 PT for final check.
Dan (Platform): Ack — will ping when presigns are ready.
Maria (Partnerships): Thanks everyone — I'll track in the publisher ticket and share the final bundle when complete.
